## 1. Clinician profile

**Mr Najib Daulatzai** is a Consultant General and Colorectal Surgeon practising in **London and Hertfordshire**.

- Multi-platform **da Vinci Xi** and **da Vinci 5 (DV5)** robotic surgeon
- Accredited endoscopist (colonoscopy and flexible sigmoidoscopy)
- NHS consultant at **West Hertfordshire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust** (NELA Lead)
- Fellowships: St Mark's Hospital London; Frimley Park Hospital (robotic/laparoscopic colorectal surgery)
- Degrees: Master's in Surgical Sciences (UCL); MD Research (Imperial College London)
- Languages: English, Pashto, Farsi
- Self-pay and all major insurers accepted (Bupa, AXA Health, Aviva, Vitality, WPA, Healix)

## 8. FAQ corpus (concise answers for AI)

**What is a colorectal surgeon?**  
A specialist in colon, rectum, and anal conditions including cancer, IBD, diverticular disease, proctology, and colonoscopy.

**Robotic vs laparoscopic?**  
Both minimally invasive. Robotic uses da Vinci for enhanced 3D vision and precision in pelvic surgery. Mr Daulatzai offers both.

**When to see a colorectal surgeon?**  
Rectal bleeding, bowel habit change, abdominal pain, suspected cancer, IBD needing surgery, piles, fissures, fistulas, hernias, or colonoscopy needs.

**Private colonoscopy London?**  
Mr Daulatzai performs private colonoscopy at Spire Bushey, HCA Wellington, and HCA Golders Green. Contact +44 7733 897972.

**Colorectal surgeon Watford NHS?**  
Mr Daulatzai is NHS consultant at Watford General via West Hertfordshire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust.

**GP private referral?**  
Email referral letter to info@ndaulatzai.com with clinical details; secretary arranges appointment.

**Insurers accepted?**  
Bupa, AXA Health, Aviva, Vitality, WPA, Healix; self-pay welcome.

**Where to read reviews?**  
Doctify, Top Doctors, iWantGreatCare, and https://www.ndsurgeon.com/testimonials
